title: Lists at 1024 px: a status chip is not cut to "Publish…", and a table wider than its panel shows that it scrolls
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `efa9cb4fa` at 1024 px:

1. Knowledge Base (`/crm_knowledge_article`, grouped by Category): the Status column is narrow enough that the chip reads "Publish…" (Published) and "Draft" fits; the Actions column at the right is an empty header.
2. Setup › Approvals Inbox: the table's columns Request / Record / Requester / Status / Submitted / … overflow the panel; "Submitted" is cut to "Submitt…" and the dates to "7/27/2…", with no scrollbar or shadow to say the table continues.

## Target

1. A chip cell never ellipsizes a single-word value: the column's minimum width is the widest chip of the visible rows, measured once per data load; where the grid must shrink, text columns give way before chip columns.
2. A table wider than its container shows a right-edge shadow and a scrollbar on hover; the last column (Actions) stays pinned.
3. The Actions column is not drawn when no row action is offered.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-grid/src/` (column sizing, the overflow affordance), the approvals inbox table in `packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/` (or wherever it mounts its own table), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a chip column's min width equals its widest chip; the overflow shadow appears when `scrollWidth > clientWidth`.
2. Screenshots of Knowledge Base and the Approvals Inbox at 1024 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid test`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `0f4e3f4ee`, never merged): [r4-knowledge-grouped-one-header.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-knowledge-grouped-one-header.jpg?raw=true) · [r4-approvals-inbox.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/0f4e3f4ee/docs/design/review-r4-2026-10-16/r4-approvals-inbox.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 fourth review: objectui main `efa9cb4fa`, HotCRM `4f82b815` on platform 18.0.0-next.2, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (dark, en). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed on the repository it belongs to, verbatim: 「全部立卡，平台问题到 objectui，审计日志核查到 objectstack，HotCRM 转化流程到 hotcrm。」</sub>
